codeReview.summary: Feature coverage is mostly present (vertical rendering, threshold routing, month annotation, and tests), but month detection has a correctness bug that mislabels non-month columns as months in wide tables.

issues.description: _detect_month_index() uses prefix matching (h.startswith(month_name)) across tokens like 'mar'. This falsely classifies non-month headers beginning with those letters (e.g., 'Marketable securities' -> month 3). Repro: html_to_vertical_text() outputs 'Marketable securities (month 3): ...', which violates expected behavior that month annotations apply only to month columns.

_annotate_month(col_header, fy_order) ignores fy_order, so fiscal-order detection is currently dead-path logic. Behavior still works for month-number annotation by name, but this is misleading and should be simplified or used explicitly to avoid maintenance drift.
